services.title: Radiation protection & compliance services
services.subtitle: Radiation Protection Services is accredited to provide compliance testing of equipment and premises in accordance with state legislative requirements.
services.clickToExpand: Click an item to see how we test it.

equipment.label: Computed Tomography (CT)
equipment.description: We test CT scanner performance including CTDI dose output, slice thickness accuracy, image uniformity, noise, and spatial resolution against national dose reference levels.

equipment.label: Mammography
equipment.description: We test mammography units for average glandular dose (AGD), image quality (contrast and resolution), compression force accuracy, and automatic exposure control performance.

equipment.label: General X-Ray
equipment.description: We test general radiography units for output consistency, kVp and timer accuracy, beam alignment, collimation accuracy, and beam filtration (HVL).

equipment.label: Fluoroscopy
equipment.description: We test fluoroscopy systems for dose rate, image quality, automatic brightness control, and beam collimation across all operating modes.

equipment.label: OPG
equipment.description: We test orthopantomography (panoramic dental) units for exposure output, image quality, and correct beam alignment and collimation.

equipment.label: Dental X-Ray
equipment.description: We test intraoral dental X-ray units for output consistency, kVp and timer accuracy, and beam collimation.

equipment.label: Veterinary X-Ray
equipment.description: We test veterinary X-ray equipment to the same output, timer, and collimation standards as human-use equipment, adapted for veterinary workflows.

equipment.label: Cabinet X-Ray
equipment.description: We test cabinet (self-shielded) X-ray units for leakage radiation at the cabinet surface, interlock function, and warning light and label compliance.

equipment.label: Chemical Analysis
equipment.description: We test X-ray fluorescence (XRF) and similar chemical-analysis X-ray devices for leakage radiation and safe interlock operation.

premises.label: Computed Tomography (CT)
premises.description: We measure radiation levels at the room boundary during typical CT workload to confirm shielding meets occupational and public dose limits.

premises.label: Mammography
premises.description: We assess mammography room shielding and layout against the lower-energy, higher-workload profile typical of breast imaging.

premises.label: General X-Ray
premises.description: We measure scatter and leakage radiation at adjacent walls, floors, and ceilings for general radiography rooms.

premises.label: Fluoroscopy
premises.description: We assess fluoroscopy room shielding, accounting for the higher workloads and longer beam-on times typical of fluoroscopic procedures.

premises.label: Dental
premises.description: We assess shielding for dental X-ray surgeries, including adjacent waiting areas and neighbouring rooms.

premises.label: Operating Theatres
premises.description: We assess shielding for theatres using mobile image intensifiers or C-arms during surgical procedures.

premises.label: Nuclear Medicine & PET
premises.description: We assess shielding and controlled-area boundaries for nuclear medicine and PET facilities handling radioactive materials.

premises.label: Laser
premises.description: We assess laser treatment room controls, signage, and eyewear requirements against applicable laser safety standards.

shielding.title: Shielding Assessments
shielding.description: We can provide shielding assessments and technical advice on new facilities as well as premises undergoing a change of use or refurbishment. We can offer you competitive prices on any assessment from a single room to a large radiology practice.

items.label: Computed Tomography
items.description: Shielding design for new or refurbished CT suites, based on planned workload and room layout.

items.label: X-Ray
items.description: Shielding design for general radiography rooms, sized to planned patient throughput and equipment output.

items.label: Fluoroscopy
items.description: Shielding design for fluoroscopy suites, accounting for extended beam-on time and higher workloads.

items.label: Dental
items.description: Shielding design for dental surgeries, including intraoral and panoramic (OPG) units.

items.label: Cath Labs & Operating Theatres
items.description: Shielding design for catheterisation labs and theatres using mobile or fixed fluoroscopy equipment.

items.label: Veterinary
items.description: Shielding design for veterinary radiography and CT rooms.

shielding.closing: We will work with your builder or architect to help you achieve a shielding outcome that provides safety for your staff and clients.

consultancy.title: Radiation & Consultancy Services
consultancy.description: We can provide radiation safety advice to practices on a range of areas including:

items.label: Radiation safety legislative requirements
items.description: We help you understand and meet the radiation safety obligations that apply to your facility under state legislation.

items.label: Radiation dosimetry
items.description: We advise on staff dosimetry programs, including badge selection, wear locations, and result monitoring.

items.label: Dose optimisation
items.description: We review your imaging protocols and technique factors to help reduce patient dose without compromising image quality.

items.label: Quality assurance
items.description: We help you set up and maintain a quality assurance program covering routine equipment checks and record-keeping.

items.label: Radiation incidents
items.description: We advise on investigating, reporting, and responding to radiation incidents or overexposures.

safetyPlans.title: Radiation Safety Plans
safetyPlans.description: We can help you develop, review and implement your Radiation Safety Protection Plans.

calculators.title: Radiation Dose Calculators
calculators.subtitle: Quick reference converters and dose estimators for radiography and CT — for clinical and educational use.
calculators.disclaimer: These calculators provide estimates for reference and educational purposes only. They are not a substitute for professional dosimetry or clinical judgment. Coefficients are sourced from published data (HPA-CRCE-028, AAPM Report No. 96, CDC/NCRP, FAA).

dapConverter.name: DAP Unit Converter
dapConverter.description: Convert dose-area product between Gy·cm² and related units.

dapToDose.name: DAP to Effective Dose (Radiography)
dapToDose.description: Estimate effective dose (mSv) from dose-area product for a given radiograph type.

cbctDose.name: CBCT Dose Calculator
cbctDose.description: Estimate effective dose (µSv) from a CBCT dose-area product, based on field-of-view size.

dlpConverter.name: DLP Unit Converter
dlpConverter.description: Convert dose-length product between Gy·cm and related units.

dlpToDose.name: DLP to Effective Dose (CT)
dlpToDose.description: Estimate effective dose (mSv) from a CT dose-length product, by patient age and body region.

doseRate.name: Dose Rate Converter
doseRate.description: Convert between dose rate units (µGy/s, mGy/h, etc.).

flight.name: Flight Radiation Calculator
flight.description: Estimate cosmic radiation exposure from flight duration.

cigarette.name: Cigarette Radiation Dose Calculator
cigarette.description: Estimate radiation dose from cigarette smoking (polonium-210 / lead-210).
